english.note: TOEFL/IELTS may be required for international applicants; accessible program catalog does not state score thresholds.

documents: Official transcripts from all postsecondary institutions
requirements.note: Bachelor's in a biological, physical or behavioral science; undergraduate biology, chemistry, physics and mathematics expected. Expected GPA 3.0 or better. Neuroscience coursework desirable, not essential; research experience an advantage.

timeline.interviews: Qualified applicants generally visit University Park for interview; international students typically interviewed virtually.

funding.note: Graduate assistantships available; no all-admitted funding guarantee in the accessible catalog.
